name: Pramipar 1mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET

PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET Works

PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).
usageDetails:
How to use PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET

Take PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with existing pulmonary diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.
PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe heart and blood vessel disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

Others

PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Psychosis (schizophrenia)

Use in pediatrics:

Use of PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET is not advisable in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

Use in geriatrics:

PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients over 65 years of age. Contact your doctor to get the correct dose.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Cimetidine, ranitidine, pantoprazole, antacids (medicines used to manage excess acid and to manage gastric ulcers)
Amantadine, levodopa, benztropine (medicines used to manage parkinson’s disease)
Mexiletine, procainamide, quinidine (medicines used to manage irregular heartbeats
Zidovudine (medicine used to manage HIV infection)
Cisplatin (medicine used to manage various types of cancers)
Quinine (medicines used to manage malaria)
Any medicines that calm you down (sedative effect)
Phenothiazines, butyrophenones, thioxanthenes (medicines used to manage schizophrenia and psychoses)
Metoclopramide (medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Diltiazem, triamterene, verapamil, hydrochlorothiazide (medicines used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases)
Cefadroxil, cefaclor, amoxicillin (medicines used for bacterial infections)
Indomethacin (medicines used to manage pain)
Chlorpropamide (medicines used to manage diabetes mellitus)

Overdosage:

If you miss a dose of PRAMIPAR 1MG TABLET, do not take double dose. If you have accidentally taken too much of this medicine, contact your doctor or nearest hospital immediately for advice. Symptoms of overdosage are vomiting, nausea, agitation, low blood pressure, hallucination, restlessness, confusion.

name: Roparil 0.25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET

ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET contains Ropinirole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopaminergic agonists. It is used to manage Parkinson’s Disease. Parkinson’s Disease is a brain disorder characterized by abnormal unintentional body parts such as tremors, loss of balance or coordination. It is caused due to low levels of a chemical called dopamine within the brain.

ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET can also be used to manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (irresistible urge to move the legs and occasionally the arms even during sleep or in rest position).

ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor, as it may lead to certain withdrawal symptoms like depression, loss of interest, anxiety, tiredness, sweating or pain. Talk to your doctor if you experience any of the above-mentioned symptoms after stopping or reducing the dose of ropinirole.

Before taking ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any mental health problems or have an habit of smoking as a precaution. Do not take ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dizziness, excessive sleepiness, hallucinations, heartburn, stomach pain swelling of the legs, feet or hands and extreme mental or physical tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Manage Parkinson’s Disease (signs include shakiness, abnormal body movements, loss of balance)
Manage the symptoms of moderate to severe idiopathic Restless Legs Syndrome (unintentional urge to move the legs)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET Works

ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist. It acts in a similar way to a natural substance called dopamine in the brain which helps in controlling body movements. As a result, it increases dopamine levels in the brain and controls abnormal body movements (such as tremors, and restless legs) associated with parkinsonism and restless leg syndrome.
usageDetails:
How to use ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET

Take ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken with meals to avoid nausea and vomiting.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

warnings.details: ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. However, your doctor may prescribe it to you after evaluating the potential risk to the foetus and benefits to the mother. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may affect the breast milk production. However, consult your doctor before taking it.
While taking ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET, avoid driving or operating heavy tools or machines if you experience drowsiness, hallucination or any other side effect that can impair your ability for driving.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of unwanted side effects.
ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET if you are allergic to Ropinirole.
ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and in adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have serious mental health problems
Have experience any unusual urges such as excessive gambling or high sexual drive
Have an habit of smoking

If you or anyone else accidentally took more ROPARIL 0.25MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include nausea, vomiting, dizziness, drowsiness, mental or physical tiredness, fainting and hallucinations.

name: Pramipar 0.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET

PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET contains Pramipexole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine agonists. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.

It is also prescribed to manage conditions such as Restless Legs Syndrome.

A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement, often including tremors. Nerve cell damage in the brain causes dopamine levels to drop, leading to the symptoms of Parkinson's.

PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET should not be given in patients with kidney diseases and psychosis. PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

This medicine is strictly for use in adults and should not be used in children and adolescents under 18 years of age.

The common side effects of taking PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET include sleepiness, dizziness, dyskinesia, nausea, hallucinations (seeing, hearing or feeling things that are not present), abnormal dreams, confusion, behavioural symptoms (Impulse control and compulsions), headache, double or blurred vision, low blood pressure, constipation, vomiting, swelling of body usually in the legs, decreased weight and appetite. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET
Used to manage signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET Works

PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET is a dopamine agonist which binds to a set of dopamine receptors in the brain. It relieves Parkinsonism by stimulating dopamine receptors present in the striatum (part of the brain that is responsible for cognition, planning, decision-making, motivation, reinforcement, and reward perception).

Take PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Cimetidine, ranitidine, pantoprazole, antacids (medicines used to manage excess acid and to manage gastric ulcers)
Amantadine, levodopa, benztropine (medicines used to manage parkinson’s disease)
Mexiletine, procainamide, quinidine (medicines used to manage irregular heartbeats
Zidovudine (medicine used to manage HIV infection)
Cisplatin (medicine used to manage various types of cancers)
Quinine (medicines used to manage malaria)
Any medicines that calm you down (sedative effect)
Phenothiazines, butyrophenones, thioxanthenes (medicines used to manage schizophrenia and psychoses)
Metoclopramide (medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Diltiazem, triamterene, verapamil, hydrochlorothiazide (medicines used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases)
Cefadroxil, cefaclor, amoxicillin (medicines used for bacterial infections)
Indomethacin (medicines used to manage pain)
Chlorpropamide (medicines used to manage diabetes mellitus)

Overdosage:

If you miss a dose of PRAMIPAR 0.5MG TABLET, do not take double dose. If you have accidentally taken too much of this medicine, contact your doctor or nearest hospital immediately for advice. Symptoms of overdosage are vomiting, nausea, agitation, low blood pressure, hallucination, restlessness, confusion.
